sources.title: kubernetes.io
sources.version_or_date: live documentation; no dated snapshot verified
sources.sections_read: NodeRestriction section, including follow-up find reads.
sources.confirmed: NodeRestriction distinguishes node identities, restricts changes to the caller's Node, and reserves a label namespace for administrator-controlled placement.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.

sources.title: Kubernetes Node authorizer
sources.sections_read: Overview, required node credentials and NodeRestriction integration.
sources.confirmed: Node authorization binds kubelet API access to a named node and limits secret reads to relationships with workloads assigned to that node.
sources.limits: It cannot make spoofed placement labels trustworthy; it must be paired with label-write restrictions and distinct authenticated node identities. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.

sources.title: Kubernetes validating admission webhooks
sources.version_or_date: live documentation; no dated snapshot verified
sources.sections_read: Webhook overview, request object/oldObject, matching, and failure policy via follow-up find reads.
sources.confirmed: Validating admission webhooks inspect requests after mutation, can reject writes, receive old and new objects, and can reject requests when the webhook fails.
sources.limits: Cover creation and all relevant updates, use a failure policy that rejects unverifiable writes, and avoid node-controlled labels as an opt-out selector. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.

sources.title: Keylime hardware-rooted identity and periodic attestation
sources.confirmed: The 2016 Keylime research describes hardware-rooted node identities and periodic integrity attestation for bare-metal and virtualized cloud nodes.
sources.limits: Requires a trustworthy hardware or virtual-TPM chain and meaningful measurements; Kubernetes label integration and revocation handling must be built separately. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.

sources.title: Kubernetes RBAC for a dedicated label-management identity
sources.version_or_date: live documentation; no dated snapshot verified
sources.sections_read: Role and ClusterRole; referring to resources and resourceNames, via follow-up find reads.
sources.confirmed: RBAC grants permissions for resources, verbs and selected resource names; permissions are additive and top-level creates cannot be limited by resourceNames.
sources.limits: RBAC grants are additive and operate at resource level; restricting individual label keys still requires admission enforcement. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.

sources.title: Kubernetes NodeRestriction admission plugin and public implementation
sources.version_or_date: live master branch; no dated commit verified
sources.sections_read: Admit, admitNode, getModifiedLabels, getForbiddenLabels, through follow-up find reads.
sources.confirmed: The public master implementation checks label changes on both Node creation and update and rejects protected keys, including administrator-reserved namespaces.
sources.limits: Use protected keys for sensitive placement; arbitrary node-writable labels remain untrusted, and the node credential format must be recognized. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.

sources.title: Cloud controller manager Node controller
sources.version_or_date: live documentation; no dated snapshot verified
sources.sections_read: Node controller functions and authorization, via follow-up find read.
sources.confirmed: The cloud controller's Node controller obtains provider-side machine information and writes identifiers, labels and addresses to Kubernetes Node objects.
sources.limits: Provider attributes do not automatically prove runtime integrity; securely bind the instance to its Node and prevent kubelets from overwriting trusted labels. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.

sources.title: Kubelet TLS bootstrap with individual node credentials
sources.sections_read: Original article date and Kubelet TLS Bootstrap general-availability section, via follow-up find read.
sources.confirmed: The 2018-09-27 release announcement describes automated per-kubelet certificate provisioning and explains why shared node identities impede node lockdown.
sources.limits: Certificate approval must bind the correct node identity; authentication alone does not certify a node's security properties or authorize sensitive labels. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C04.json.
